active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: 719a remains frozen as the current risk-manager baseline candidate. 728a/OAS-G1 tried the single allowed generic high-no-change tail-asinh coordinate repair and was rejected on anchor_only before tri-scope evaluation because BBB OAS KS worsened versus 719a. Sticky quoted spread factors are now documented as a known limitation rather than an axis for further knob stacking. Next active direction is VIX extension/generalization testing.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: The current risk-manager candidate is not blocked by broad realism: IV temporal/spatial realism, anchor/joint factor tail scale, conditional panel response, and IV-factor co-movement are acceptable under 719a. The unresolved issues are IV calibration and sticky quoted-spread daily-change shape; the clean OAS coordinate repair failed, so further spread-specific tuning is now considered a limitation risk. The next bottleneck is whether the same framework generalizes cleanly when VIX is added as a scalar volatility factor.
last_result_summary: 728a implemented `hybrid_tail_asinh`, a generic high-no-change coordinate selected by train no-change rate. On anchor_only, it selected only AAA/BBB OAS and used train-derived nonzero normalized scales 1.04/0.85. After the same 719-compatible rollout/channel fine-tune plus sticky-zero readout, anchor quality was finite=1.0, factor KS mean 0.1016, 12/13 pass, BBB KS 0.259, AAA KS 0.171, q99 tail pass 13/13, factor corr upper 0.861, conditional MAE improvement 5.17%. This is worse than 719a on BBB KS and dependence, so OAS-G1 is rejected.
next_step_recommendation: Do not add another OAS repair knob. Freeze 719a as the risk-manager baseline with sticky OAS as a documented limitation, then run VIX-X1: add VIX to the anchor panel if available, rebuild the generic input panel, and evaluate whether the same state-aware normalized-innovation AR flow plus sticky readout handles IV-only, anchor+VIX, and joint+VIX without special treatment.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain historical IV-only controls. For current risk-manager multi-factor deployment, 719a is the baseline candidate: IV 7/11 with broad temporal/spatial realism, anchor/joint factor tails and conditional response passing, IV-factor co-movement passing, and residual failures concentrated in IV calibration plus BBB/AAA OAS sticky-spread marginals.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
